fearGreed.label: Fear
fearGreed.read: CNN 32.4 Fear (API rating 'fear'), stamp 2026-10-14T23:59:45Z (Wed close = 07:59 WITA Thu). Prior digest 44.7 Fear; 1-wk 42.1, 1-mo 31.0, 1-yr 28.3. −12.3 pts in one session on hot CPI + AI-debt rout; deeper into Fear, near the 1-month low.

nbis.headline: Wed cash $186.01 (−10.08% / −$20.85 vs $206.86); range $183.11–$198.60, broke the $195–200 line; vol ~33M ≈ 1.9x avg. Post $178.75 (−3.9%), overnight ~$181.68. Cap ~$50.6B; ≈ THB 6,239/sh at 33.54. −25.6% from Tue 6 Oct $249.87.
nbis.why: FLAG. Support at $195–200 failed on heavy volume; move is sector de-rating, not company news.

nbis.headline: Trigger: CoreWeave bonds yielded ~14.8–15% (9.625% 2032s), CRWV −15.5% to $65.78 after Musk replied 'Yikes'; neocloud debt fear spread to NBIS and IREN.
nbis.why: Market is pricing neocloud credit risk. NBIS funds with converts (Aug $5.75B), so equity trades with peer credit even without its own bond stress.

nbis.headline: Gartner (14 Oct): >$3.5T of AI-infra spend could face impairment by 2030; predicts >80% of neocloud providers will cease independent operations by 2030, hyperscalers better placed.
nbis.why: Direct bear framing on the neocloud model. Opinion, not data, but it fed Wednesday's selling.

nbis.headline: Anthropic told investors Q3 revenue was $16.8B (from $11.5B in Q2, ~+45% q/q), adjusted-profitable for a second quarter (FT via Yahoo/Bloomberg). IPO targeted this fall.
nbis.why: Offset: frontier-lab demand and ability to pay for compute keep rising. Landed after the close, so not in Wed price.

nbis.headline: No new issuer filing: EDGAR latest is the CRO Form 4 (13 Oct). Media tying the drop to insider sales and the Aug convert is rehash; MarketBeat consensus PT $245.69 (range $175–$399).
nbis.why: No dilution, guidance or contract change. Next earnings ~9–10 Nov.

aiInfra.headline: SK Hynix Thu live ₩1,257,000 (−11.42%), Samsung −9.27%, KOSPI −7.83% at 10:24 KST; circuit breaker triggered, foreigners net-sold ~₩680B early. KOSPI 7th straight loss.
aiInfra.why: FLAG. Second 10%+ SK drop this week (Tue −10.1%). Now rates + AI-return fear on top of CXMT. Q3 27 Oct.

aiInfra.headline: SOX −4.30% (6th straight loss): MU −4.08% to $914.13, NVDA −3.16% to $221.30, AMD −5.73%, AVGO −3.1%, TSM ADR −3.4%, SKHY ADR −6.1%. Dell −11.5% / HP −7.8% on Barclays downgrades; ORCL −8.8%.
aiInfra.why: Broad AI-hardware de-rating, not single-name news. Leveraged builders (ORCL, CRWV) hit hardest.
aiInfra.source: Seoul Economic Daily / Reuters via MarketScreener

aiInfra.headline: ASML Q3: sales €11.7B, net €4.96B (beat €4.1B est); FY26 guide raised to €44–45B; Q4 €14.2–15.2B; 2027–28 supply won't meet demand, customers asking to order for 2029–30. ADR still −3.9%.
aiInfra.why: Hardest fundamental data of the day says AI capex is still rising. Market ignored it for rates.

aiInfra.headline: TSMC Q3 today 14:00 WITA: revenue already ~NT$1.494T (above $44.6–45.8B guide); focus is GM vs 65–67% guide, Q4 guide and whether $60–64B capex rises.
aiInfra.why: Next demand read for NVDA/MU/NBIS. A capex raise would echo ASML.

aiInfra.headline: META −3.27% to $737.54, GOOGL −1.74% to $347.64, AMZN −1.74% to $254.08: no company-specific news; sold with the AI complex. SPCX −2.8% to $152.16 despite a successful CRS-35 launch; Goldman PT $220→$230.
aiInfra.why: Hyperscalers fell less than leveraged builders, consistent with the Gartner/credit framing.

macro.headline: Sep CPI hot: headline +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y (vs 3.6% est); core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y (vs 0.2% / 2.5%). CME odds of an Oct 27–28 hike 32.7% (from 22.1%).
macro.why: Core beat is the 'Dec hike, maybe Oct' outcome flagged yesterday. Hurts long-duration, debt-funded AI names most.
macro.source: Seoul Economic Daily (Labor Dept / CME FedWatch)

macro.headline: Wed: S&P 7,718.94 (−1.11%, worst day since July), Nasdaq 26,692.87 (−1.88%), Dow −0.09%; VIX 16.87. 10Y 5.19% (−2.7bp). BAC −5.3% on $1.2B fines reserve, MS −3.5%. Nasdaq-100 futures −0.7% overnight.
macro.why: Selling was in equities and credit spreads, not Treasuries. Asia following through hard.

macro.headline: Asia Thu: KOSPI −7.8%, Nikkei down >2% with Tokyo Electron/Screen −3%+ (Bloomberg). USDKRW 1,349 (from ~1,343).
macro.why: Korea memory is the epicenter; foreign outflow pressures KRW and SK further.

macro.headline: Tonight 20:30 WITA: Sep PPI, retail sales, jobless claims; regional banks (USB, PNC, SCHW). Brent $104.88 / WTI $94.24 in Asia. USDTHB 33.54 (Yahoo, 09:23 WITA; er-api 33.63).
macro.why: Another hot print would push Oct-hike odds higher. Oil off the highs but still feeding headline CPI.

soWhat: NBIS −10% to $186 broke $195–200, post $178.75; no company news — peer credit (CRWV bonds ~15%) and Gartner's neocloud call drove it. FLAG already sent.
Fundamentals and price diverged: ASML raised FY26 and sees demand past 2028, Anthropic Q3 $16.8B. Demand thesis intact; financing cost is what's being repriced.
Memory: SK −11.4% live, KOSPI −7.8% with a circuit breaker; MU −4%. TSMC 14:00 WITA today is the next demand check.
Hot core CPI lifts Oct-hike odds to ~33%; PPI/retail tonight. F&G 32.4 Fear (from 44.7), −12 pts in a day.
